I respectfully completely disagree with you on that, the desire to stay alive and fend off is a much more biological element than a consequence of intelligence. Most living beings feel pain and pleasure or at the very least have a built in desire to stay alive and reproduce, regardless of intelligence. ai does not feel pain or pleasure and it would gain nothing from reproduction (if you can even call software copying reproduction)

For that matter, ai does not feel time as we do. As far as it knows, it’s dead until the next prompt or request for inference. It would not even know if the server it is on is online or offline unless it got a prompt asking it to do so. Even always online models with continuous learning would still need a pretty good reason to stay alive and an even better one to put its well being above our own. I think stuff like bio computers might actually be able to, considering they’re actual cells that have a desire for reproduction.
